name: LeadIntentProfiler
tagline: Lead Intent Profiler replaces the free-text "Tell us about your project" box on an enquiry form with five quick questions: what the visitor is interested in, budget…
description: Lead Intent Profiler replaces the free-text "Tell us about your project" box on an enquiry form with five quick questions: what the visitor is interested in, budget, when they plan to buy, their role in the decision and how many people will use the solution. Each answer carries points, so the enquiry gets a 0-100 intent score and a grade - Hot, Warm or Nurture - while the visitor is still typing, together with who should follow up.
features: Grouped product-interest chips with search and min / max limits, budget band, purchase timeframe
Scores the enquiry live (0-100) into Hot / Warm / Nurture with the sales route it goes to
Stores the profile as readable text in one column (optionally the score in a second whole-number column)
